title: Instance started
description: An instance started at its trigger. The payload never carries the input. The event's aggregate is `instance/<instanceId>`.

instanceId.description: The instance the fact is about.

definitionCode.description: The definition's code, stable across versions.

version.description: The published version the instance pins.

status.description: The instance's status after the fact.

startedBy.description: The audit name of who or what started it.
